items.exampleEn: Practically everyone in the office came to the party.
items.exampleZh: 辦公室裡幾乎每個人都來參加派對了。

items.exampleEn: Her gross salary is fifty thousand dollars a month.
items.exampleZh: 她的稅前月薪是五萬元。

items.exampleEn: The number of students at the village school has shrunk to twenty.
items.exampleZh: 這所村莊小學的學生人數已縮減到二十人。

items.exampleEn: He cut the cheese into small chunks.
His English was inadequate for the job, so he took evening classes.
items.exampleZh: 他的英文不足以勝任這份工作，所以他去上夜間課程。

items.exampleEn: There has been a surge in online orders this month.
Scientists found the remains of a huge fish in the rock.
items.exampleZh: 科學家在岩石裡發現一條巨大魚類的遺跡。

items.exampleEn: The river widens as it gets closer to the sea.
items.exampleZh: 河流越接近海就變得越寬。

items.sentenceEn: The company's gross income rose by ten percent this year.
items.sentenceZh: 公司今年的總收入增加了百分之十。

items.audioEn: This meeting room is practically full. Let's move to the bigger one.
items.audioZh: 這間會議室幾乎坐滿了。我們換到大一點的那間吧。

items.sentenceEn: Our profits have shrunk because the cost of materials went up.
items.sentenceZh: 因為原料成本上漲，我們的利潤縮水了。

items.sentenceEn: A big chunk of my salary goes to rent.
items.sentenceZh: 我薪水的一大部分都花在房租上。

items.stemEn: When the pipe broke, a sudden ____ of water flooded the kitchen.
items.stemZh: 水管破裂時，一股水突然湧出，淹了廚房。

items.stemEn: The old bridge is too narrow, so the city plans to ____ it.
items.stemZh: 那座舊橋太窄了，所以市政府計畫把它拓寬。

items.passageEn: Twenty years ago, our town was practically empty. Most young people had moved to the city, and the population kept shrinking. Then a large factory opened nearby, and the town saw a sudden surge of new residents. The town was not ready: its roads and schools were inadequate for so many people. The local government spent a large chunk of its budget on improvements that were urgently needed. It widened the main road and built two new schools. Workers even found the remains of an old wall while they were digging. Today, the gross income of local businesses is three times higher than before.
items.passageZh: 二十年前，我們鎮上幾乎沒什麼人。大部分年輕人都搬到城市去了，人口不斷減少。後來附近開了一座大工廠，新居民突然大增。小鎮還沒準備好：道路和學校都不足以應付這麼多人。地方政府把一大部分預算花在急需的改善建設上。它拓寬了主要道路，蓋了兩所新學校。工人在挖地時甚至發現了一道古牆的遺跡。如今，當地商家的總收入是以前的三倍。

questions.questionZh: 工廠開了之後發生了什麼事？
工人在挖地時發現了什麼？

items.promptZh: 以這個專案來說，我們的人手不足。
referenceEn: The number of staff is inadequate for this project.
We have an inadequate number of workers for this project.
rubricZh: inadequate 表示「不足的、不夠的」（例如 is inadequate for…、an inadequate number of…）
「人手」可寫 staff、workers、people 等；寫 not enough staff 意思也對

items.promptZh: 這輛舊車現在幾乎不值錢了。
referenceEn: This old car is practically worthless now.
This old car is worth practically nothing now.
rubricZh: practically 表示「幾乎」（例如 practically worthless、worth practically nothing 等）
「不值錢」可寫，例如 worthless、worth nothing 等
